responsibility: Defines the higher-ranked binder wrapper used throughout the type IR to represent values quantified over bound lifetimes, types, or consts, and provides the core operations for safely constructing, traversing, validating, and instantiating bound values across binder levels. It is the crate’s central machinery for managing De Bruijn-indexed bound variables, including skipping or mapping binders, substituting generic arguments, and shifting escaping variables when values are moved through nested binders.
